Live: Mamata Banerjee calls SIR 'Special Incentive for Ruling party', demands CEC's arrestSIR Dissent Row Live Updates: A political row has erupted over the Election Commission's Special Intensive Revision exercise after the Opposition, citing an Indian Express report, claimed that two Election Commissioners had dissented with Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar over various aspects of the nationwide exercise. The report claimed the two commissioners had formally objected 14 times to different aspects of the SIR over the past 10 months. The EC rejected the report, saying its decisions were being taken unanimously and that individual deliberations did not reflect the poll panel's final stand. BJP defended the EC's process, saying its detailed note showed that official deliberations had taken place among all Election Commissioners and that they were ultimately "on the same page". He said the EC was following a democratic process, not a "dictatorial rule". Meanwhile, Congress MP Rahul Gandhi accused the EC and BJP of an "act of treason" and called "vote chori" a "crime against the Indian people". AAP chief Arvind Kejriwal and other Opposition leaders have demanded the arrest of Gyanesh Kumar and cancellation of the SIR exercise. Follow indiatoday.in for live updates.
